english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a floor or level of a building below ground.
Use this for the basement level or underground part of a building, rather than a storage cellar.

examples.english: We parked our car in the basement.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaa3 ce1 paak3 zo2 hai2 dei6 fu3

examples.english: We parked our car in the mall's cellar.
examples.traditional: 我哋架車泊喺商場地庫。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaa3 ce1 paak3 hai2 soeng1 coeng4 dei6 fu3
